procedural_matters: David Hudson, Lauren Twigg and Jan Kemp observing.
facts: The incident occured in the racing area.
NZL 19 did not hail protest nor did he inform NZL 9 of his intention to protest.
conclusions: NZL 19 failed to hail protest as required by RRS 60.2(a)(1)
therefore the protest is invalid as per RRS 60.4(a)(1).
